title: Crumb: how does an AI agent get a logged-in browser for a saved account?
scope: The crumb launch flow: agent CLI call, detached supervisor, Chrome over CDP, encrypted vault, and OS key store.
omissions: Interactive login and capture from an existing browser

groups.label: Agent host
groups.description: Local coding agent and its hook, user-run

groups.label: Crumb local processes
groups.description: Local self-hosted Node CLI, supervisor and Chrome

groups.label: Local state and OS
groups.description: Local filesystem vault and OS key store

nodes.label: AI agent
nodes.description: Runs crumb commands, drives the browser via CDP

nodes.label: Vault guard
nodes.description: Blocks agent tool calls that reference ~/.crumb

nodes.label: Crumb CLI
nodes.description: Starts the supervisor, waits for handle, prints it

nodes.label: Supervisor
nodes.description: Detached process: injects state, autosaves session

nodes.label: Chrome
nodes.description: Local Chrome exposing a CDP endpoint

nodes.label: Session vault
nodes.description: Encrypted .crumb entries plus run handle files

nodes.label: OS key store
nodes.description: Holds vault key; falls back to CRUMB_KEY or key file

notes.title: Fails closed on key
notes.text: Missing key in configured store throws KEY_UNAVAILABLE; never mints a new key over an existing vault.

notes.title: Autosave and merge
notes.text: Supervisor saves every 30s, on SIGUSR2 and SIGTERM, 3-way merging so concurrent runs don't clobber.

notes.title: Start timeout
notes.text: CLI polls for the handle up to 60s; supervisor errors surface via a .error file, else INTERNAL.
